items.name: Construa: kubectl (mkube)
items.desc: Go CLI that recreates kubectl to explore how Kubernetes works internally. The project includes 12 steps: API connection and authentication, context management, resource querying, real-time logs, command execution in containers, manifest application, and port-forward. To be developed in the Construa training, by LINUXtips.

items.name: Giropops Status — Linux para Cloud Native
items.desc: Web application that monitors HTTP service availability, records check history, and displays a status dashboard with Prometheus metrics. Built with Python, Flask, and Redis, the project will be used to practice Linux administration: SSH, permissions, systemd, log analysis, backups, and deploy automation. To be developed in the Linux para Cloud Native course, by LINUXtips.

items.name: PICKStack — PICK 2026
items.desc: Study platform with Pomodoro sessions, spaced repetition flashcards, and career paths, organized into microservices with Deno and SvelteKit. At PICK 2026, the challenge will be to operate this application: create Docker images, publish on Kubernetes, configure Helm and GitOps with ArgoCD, and monitor metrics, logs, and traces. Project to be developed during LINUXtips' training.
